title: Tensor constructor for actual strict quotient adjuncts
statement:
Fix a prime l and a finite extension E of ℚ_l, with scheme and coefficient universes independent. Complex, level, transition, ordinaryAlpha and the named constructor predicates refer to the actual strict ringed sequence-site complexes and maps [def-pur-strict-quotient-expressions]. S and D range over the normalized derived tensor and finite quotient calculi, whose units and tensor model are pinned [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus]. The following holds for all displayed schemes, maps, complexes and levels (level n denotes exponent n+1):

theorem strictTensorAdjointConstructor {W : Scheme.{t}} (U V : Complex l E W) :
    TensorTransitions l E U V ∧
    ∀ (S : CoefficientDerivedSystemTensors l E W)
      (D : CoefficientFiniteQuotientCalculus l E W S) {m n : ℕ} (hmn : n ≤ m)
      (hUm : Good l E U m) (hVm : Good l E V m)
      (hUn : Good l E U n) (hVn : Good l E V n),
      (IsIso (ordinaryAlpha l E U S D hmn) →
        IsIso (ordinaryAlpha l E V S D hmn) →
        IsIso (ordinaryAlpha l E (total l E U V) S D hmn)) ∧
      TensorAdjointEquation l E U V S D hmn hUm hVm hUn hVn

proof.text: Apply the fully proved ordinary tensor adjunct factorization to the normalized comparison supplied by D.tensor_model. If the two factor adjuncts are invertible, extension of scalars applied to the evaluation isomorphism, the scalar tensor isomorphism, the tensor of the factor adjuncts and inverse target evaluation are all invertible. This proves the ordinary IsIso clause.

proof.text: Transport K-flatness of the finite total tensor across the ordinary evaluation isomorphism. The derived adjunction unit_model gives alpha equal to its canonical scalar computation followed by localization of ordinaryAlpha. Naturality of the universal scalar counit gives its naturality square, and naturality of CoefficientTensorModels.comparison gives the finite tensor model square.

proof.text: Apply D.tensor_model to the two source-level K-flat complexes and its normalized ordinary comparison. Substitute the ordinary factorization, the scalar model naturality square, the finite tensor model naturality square and the three alpha computation formulas. Functoriality and associativity paste these squares into exactly TensorAdjointEquation with the specified tensorComparison at both levels.
